notes: The 'of' after 'am full' is given to אֵת under rule 16's first family; the alternative is an unrepresented marker with 'full of' whole on the verb.
בַּחוּרִים → 'of young men' is headed on 'men' as the noun of 'of + noun'; heading it on 'young' under rule 31's subtraction remains defensible and the unit note records the tie.
'it' in 'pour it out' is added because שְׁפֹךְ carries no object suffix (rule 44's supplied-object clause).
